description.value:
Released shortly after the D5 Copperhead’s success, the Longnose was marketed as a ‘super-portable heavy machine gun.’ In obvious reality, it’s just a Copperhead with a heavier barrel and quad-stack magazines. While a letdown to Nokota’s sales department, the few Longnoses that do sell typically end up in the hands of Nomads and militias that can’t afford the latest smartlinked lead-spitters, or just prefer the freedom to customize. As the saying goes, one corp’s trash is another gonk’s iron.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Machine Gun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Assault Rifle

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 4 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Has 1 additional Attachment Slot (4 Total). Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions.

Range: Assault Rifle
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
